(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyze the network data to identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat while incorporating at least one unique aspect of the network environment.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including detailed information about the mitigating action taken for the malicious network threat to a third party device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving a network data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyzing the network data to identify a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat while incorporating at least one unique aspect of the network environment.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification that includes detailed information about the mitigating action taken for the malicious network threat to a third party device.
